product_metadata.title: Full Circle Ziptuck Reusable Snack Bags – Multi-Use Leak-Free Food-Safe Storage Bags – BPA-Free – Set of 2, Cactus Party
features: SET OF 2 REUSABLE BAGS: Our Ziptuck Snack Bag set is a great way to banish disposable food baggies; Designed to perfectly store and transport your snacks when you’re on the go; each 7" x 4.6", 1.5 cups, 12.17 oz

LEAK-PROOF & AIRTIGHT: The food storage bags have a secure Ziptuck closure, which has an air-tight ‘lock’ seal designed to keep your food fresh; the travel bags are also leak-proof and suitable for liquids
STYLE AND FUNCTION: Finished with a choice of patterns, the food-safe reusable snack bags stand upright when in use for easy filling, and flatten for easy packing and storage
EASY CARE DESIGN: Label and wipe clean with a dry erase marker; our BPA-free reusable plastic bags are hand washable in warm, soapy water; rounded corners make cleaning a breeze
EARTH FRIENDLY MATERIALS: Made from FDA-Grade EVA material and supplied with minimal, sustainable packaging; Full Circle is a certified B-Corp company, plastic neutral and ship carbon neutral
description: ZIPTUCK SNACK BAG SET: Full Circle Reusable Food Storage Bags are the perfect replacement for disposable plastic lunch baggies that are destined for landfill. This reusable snack bag set includes 2 snack bags with a gusset base that allows them to stand upright for easy filling and snacking. Food-safe and BPA free, the durable storage bags feature a Ziptuck closure with an airtight ‘lock’ seal, strong seams and a leak-free design – the food bags are even suitable for holding liquids. Distinctive patterns are a great way to prevent snack-time mix-ups (though you can also label and wipe clean with a dry erase marker), and when not in use the reusable snack bags fold flat for easy storage in a backpack or drawer. Bringing inspiration and fun to daily household rituals, we believe that aesthetics and efficacy should never be sacrificed. These reusable food bags are made from BPA-free, chlorine-free PEVA material – a food-safe alternative to PVC. While it’s not plastic-free, the food bag’s reusable design encourages repeated use, which helps us to achieve our goal of changing behaviors. Your food storage bags are easy to care for - we recommend hand washing in warm soapy water, inside out (it’s easier and they dry quicker!). At Full Circle, we make beautifully designed, functionally innovative home care products from safe and sustainable materials to benefit this and future generations, and preserve the world we all share. We are plastic and carbon neutral, which means that for every ounce of plastic we use, we work with Plastic Bank® to recover and recycle the same amount of plastic that would otherwise enter our oceans, and through Carbon Fund we’re offsetting all emissions from international shipping.
